title: GitHub-style #123 cross-references
notes: Type #123 in a post to reference another topic — it renders as a chip showing that topic's current title and is recorded just like pasting its link. When someone references your topic (by #123 or a pasted link) you now get a notification, and it shows in the target's "Mentioned in" box.

changelog.text: Reference another topic with the #123 shorthand — it renders as a live-title chip and is recorded like a pasted link, so renames flow through automatically.
Get notified when someone references your topic, and see it in the "Mentioned in" box.
